Definition: to kiss, literally or figuratively (touch); also (as a mode of attachment), to equip with weapons
BiblicalUsage: 1) to put together, kiss; 1a) (Qal) to kiss; 1b) (Piel) to kiss; 1c) (Hiphil) to touch gently; 2) to handle, be equipped with; 2a) (Qal) to be equipped
